title: Hub signals inbox triage pattern: 16/18 already covered, batch archive viable
signal: S119 triaged 18 hub incoming signals. 16 already had corresponding spoke teachings, implemented code, or existing lugs — batch-archived without new lug creation. Pattern: hub inbox accumulates signals that were already incorporated via other paths (session teachings, direct commits, CLAUDE.md). A fast pre-triage check (compare signal IDs against processed/ + existing lugs) can clear 80-90% of inbox in one pass before detailed review.
rationale: Inbox triage was blocked at 19 items for 3 sessions. Root cause: no fast pre-check for already-processed signals. Pattern reusable across all spokes.
